\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 179-182 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:BN-R187-first-pass-words-from-chapters-179-182}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a decade and a weekend.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to taste, to swallow, to chew, to look, to pick
  \item to earn, to look after, to rear, to water, to print
  \item to breathe, to shiver, to get wet, to memorise, to explain
  \item to tear, to fold, to gather, to share, to add
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To taste? (\textbf{\bn{চাখা}}, \emph{chākhā}.) To swallow? (\textbf{\bn{গেলা}}, \emph{gelā}.) To chew? (\textbf{\bn{চিবানো}}, \emph{chibāno}.) To look? (\textbf{\bn{তাকানো}}, \emph{tākāno}.) To pick? (\textbf{\bn{বাছা}}, \emph{bāchhā}.) To earn? (\textbf{\bn{রোজগার} \bn{করা}}, \emph{rojgār kôrā}.) To look after? (\textbf{\bn{দেখাশোনা} \bn{করা}}, \emph{dækhāshonā kôrā}.) To rear? (\textbf{\bn{পালা}}, \emph{pālā}.) To water? (\textbf{\bn{জল} \bn{দেওয়া}}, \emph{jôl deoyā}.) To print? (\textbf{\bn{ছাপা}}, \emph{chhāpā}.) To breathe? (\textbf{\bn{নিঃশ্বাস} \bn{নেওয়া}}, \emph{niḥshvās neoyā}.) To shiver? (\textbf{\bn{কাঁপা}}, \emph{kā̃pā}.) To get wet? (\textbf{\bn{ভেজা}}, \emph{bhejā}.) To memorise? (\textbf{\bn{মুখস্থ} \bn{করা}}, \emph{mukhôsthô kôrā}.) To explain? (\textbf{\bn{বোঝানো}}, \emph{bojhāno}.) To tear? (\textbf{\bn{ছেঁড়া}}, \emph{chhẽṛā}.) To fold? (\textbf{\bn{ভাঁজ} \bn{করা}}, \emph{bhā̃j kôrā}.) To gather? (\textbf{\bn{জড়ো} \bn{করা}}, \emph{jôṛo kôrā}.) To share? (\textbf{\bn{ভাগ} \bn{করা}}, \emph{bhāg kôrā}.) To add? (\textbf{\bn{যোগ} \bn{করা}}, \emph{jog kôrā}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 183-187 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:BN-R187-second-pass-words-from-chapters-183-187}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for to scratch and to yawn.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to scratch, to yawn, to snore, to wake up, to bathe
  \item to accept, to agree, to force, to obstruct, to take a risk
  \item a pill, an injection, an injury, a blister, a bandage
  \item a rib, a navel, a palm; the palate, the brain, a muscle
  \item on time, a century, an era, a decade, a weekend
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To scratch? (\textbf{\bn{চুলকানো}}, \emph{chulkāno}.) To yawn? (\textbf{\bn{হাই} \bn{তোলা}}, \emph{hāi tolā}.) To snore? (\textbf{\bn{নাক} \bn{ডাকা}}, \emph{nāk ḍākā}.) To wake up? (\textbf{\bn{জাগা}}, \emph{jāgā}.) To bathe? (\textbf{\bn{স্নান} \bn{করা}}, \emph{snān kôrā}.) To accept? (\textbf{\bn{মেনে} \bn{নেওয়া}}, \emph{mene neoyā}.) To agree? (\textbf{\bn{রাজি} \bn{হওয়া}}, \emph{rāji hôoyā}.) To force? (\textbf{\bn{জোর} \bn{করা}}, \emph{jor kôrā}.) To obstruct? (\textbf{\bn{বাধা} \bn{দেওয়া}}, \emph{bādhā deoyā}.) To take a risk? (\textbf{\bn{ঝুঁকি} \bn{নেওয়া}}, \emph{jhũki neoyā}.) A pill? (\textbf{\bn{বড়ি}}, \emph{bôṛi}.) An injection? (\textbf{\bn{ইনজেকশন}}, \emph{injekshôn}.) An injury? (\textbf{\bn{চোট}}, \emph{choṭ}.) A blister? (\textbf{\bn{ফোসকা}}, \emph{phoskā}.) A bandage? (\textbf{\bn{ব্যান্ডেজ}}, \emph{bænḍej}.) A rib? (\textbf{\bn{পাঁজর}}, \emph{pā̃jôr}.) A navel? (\textbf{\bn{নাভি}}, \emph{nābhi}.) A palm; the palate? (\textbf{\bn{তালু}}, \emph{tālu}.) The brain? (\textbf{\bn{মগজ}}, \emph{môgôj}.) A muscle? (\textbf{\bn{পেশি}}, \emph{peshi}.) On time? (\textbf{\bn{সময়মতো}}, \emph{sômôymôto}.) A century? (\textbf{\bn{শতাব্দী}}, \emph{shôtābdī}.) An era? (\textbf{\bn{যুগ}}, \emph{jug}.) A decade? (\textbf{\bn{দশক}}, \emph{dôshôk}.) A weekend? (\textbf{\bn{সপ্তাহান্ত}}, \emph{sôptāhāntô}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
